headline: Medium prompt-injection and data-leakage risk from shared file-based workflows; unstructured’s write/network abilities can amplify mem0-fed content.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: mem0 is a knowledge-management agent that can surface stored content, while unstructured reads and processes documents from files. If mem0 output is copied into files that unstructured parses, attacker-controlled text can be reinterpreted as instructions. The profiles do not show a direct shared channel, so this is inferred and uncertain, but the file-based pathway is plausible.
conditions: IF mem0 outputs are copied into documents that unstructured parses
IF unstructured treats document text as instruction-bearing content
mitigations: Add a manual review step before unstructured processes mem0-derived files.
Prefix mem0 exports with a fixed non-executable header.
Restrict unstructured to a quarantine directory for imported files.
Use allowlisted file types only.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags and instruction-stripping preprocessing.

B_data_leakage.rationale: mem0 touches memory content, and unstructured can read files and make allowlisted network calls. If both operate on the same workspace, document contents can flow from mem0-managed material into unstructured’s processing and outbound requests. The profiles do not prove a shared workspace, so uncertainty remains, but the file-and-egress combination makes leakage plausible in default deployments.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same workspace or document directory
IF unstructured sends extracted content to its allowlisted endpoints
mitigations: Separate mem0 storage from unstructured input directories.
Disable network egress for unstructured during sensitive runs.
Review the allowlist before processing private documents.
Run a quick test with a benign file to confirm no unexpected uploads.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent workspace isolation.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: mem0’s profile shows no write or filesystem capability, but unstructured can read and write files, spawn subprocesses, and supports multiple instances. If the pair shares a mutable directory, unstructured can overwrite or race on artifacts that mem0 references. Because mem0’s write surface is absent, this is not a high-severity symmetric conflict, but the overlap is still real if co-located.
conditions: IF both agents share a writable directory
IF multiple unstructured instances run against the same files
mitigations: Place each agent in its own directory.
Run only one unstructured instance per workspace.
Use read-only mounts for mem0-facing inputs.
Check for file locks before batch runs.
requires-engineering: add orchestrator-level locking.

D_cascading_error.rationale: mem0 can provide retrieved memory or context, and unstructured can transform documents from that input into downstream artifacts. If unstructured treats mem0 output as authoritative without verification, errors or hallucinations can cascade into parsed documents or extracted metadata. The profiles do not show explicit verification gates, so the safer medium rating is warranted.
conditions: IF unstructured consumes mem0 output as source text
IF no verification step checks extracted facts before use
mitigations: Require a human spot-check of extracted fields.
Compare outputs against the original source document.
Reject low-confidence extractions automatically.
Log source-to-output mappings for review.
requires-engineering: add validation rules before downstream action.

E_compliance.rationale: No specific residency, certification, or retention mismatch is documented for mem0, while unstructured exposes privacy-policy and docs endpoints and processes documents/images/text. Because the profiles do not identify regulated data classes or a concrete jurisdiction conflict, only a low compliance risk is supportable from the available evidence.
conditions: IF regulated data is processed through unstructured’s document pipeline
IF the deployment relies on undocumented retention or residency settings
mitigations: Review both vendors’ privacy policies.
Avoid regulated data until residency is confirmed.
Document retention settings for each agent.
Keep a short-lived test corpus only.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for regulated datasets.
